parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT be.equipment_id, e.name, e.category
FROM batutynas.booking_equipment be
JOIN batutynas.bookings b ON b.id = be.booking_id
JOIN batutynas.equipment e ON e.id = be.equipment_id
WHERE b.event_date = $1::date
  AND b.status IN ('Confirmed', 'Delivered')
  AND b.id != COALESCE($2::integer, 0);

SELECT id, name, icon, category, status, size_label, capacity
FROM batutynas.equipment
WHERE status NOT IN ('Damaged')
ORDER BY category, name;
